blocks.text: Glade is a city in Phillips County, Kansas, United States. As of the 2020 census, the population of the city was 52.

Glade is an unincorporated community in Scioto Township, Jackson County, Ohio, United States. It is located southeast of Beaver at the intersection of the James A. Rhodes Appalachian Highway and Glade Road, at 39°00′48″N 82°46′58″W.
